run_f_gold: run f_gold to segregate even and odd numbers in an array in-place
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array and count n to partition even numbers to the front
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a Lomuto partition-style approach to segregate even and odd numbers
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that moves even numbers to the front of an array and prints results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the segregated array instead of printing elements directly
